content: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) recommends the use of specific diagnostic tests for the screening of prediabetes and type 2 diabetes. These tests include fasting plasma glucose (FPG), which measures blood glucose levels after an overnight fast; the 2-hour plasma glucose (PG) test conducted during an oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT), which evaluates the body's ability to process glucose after consuming a glucose-rich solution; and the A1C test, which provides an average of blood glucose levels over the past two to three months. Each of these tests is considered appropriate for identifying individuals at risk or diagnosing these conditions.
